reviews.body:
From my perspective this can be merged. `TextQuery("the a an")` now raises the same `ValueError` as `AggregateHybridQuery`, and the shared helper is byte for byte the old tokenizer plus that check, so no other query changes.

non-blocking: the MCP fulltext tool builds a `TextQuery` too, and `map_exception` turns the new `ValueError` into a clean invalid-request error, which beats the Redis syntax error it got before.

```
$ python rv_repro.py        # construction half of the #821 repro, base 930c14e vs head c18f796
base: 'the a an' -> @body:()
head: 'the a an' -> ValueError: text string cannot be empty after removing stopwords

$ pytest -q --noconftest tests/unit/test_text_query_weights.py tests/unit/test_query_types.py tests/unit/test_aggregation_types.py   # head, Python 3.12
83 passed, 1 skipped in 1.21s

$ (same, base query.py, head tests)
FAILED tests/unit/test_text_query_weights.py::test_text_query_rejects_empty_tokenized_text[the a an-english]
4 failed, 79 passed, 1 skipped in 0.62s
# not run: live Redis, the integration suite
```

I'll send the escaped-token fix as the follow-up once this is in.
